newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq off at close, Peak takes a fall.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq off at close, Peak takes a fall.

text.p: Peak Technologies Group Inc on Thursday offered another reminder of just how brutal the preannouncement season can be when its warned of a third quarter shortfall and fell 9-7/8 to 11-7/8 in active trade.
The company said that weaker sales, order delays and one order cancelation would result in third quarter earnings of break-even. The First Call consensus was for net per share of $0.31.
Peak helped account for a weak Nasdaq after Wednesday's rally. The Nasdaq Composite was down 2.96 points or 0.24 percent at 1233.15 at its unofficial close.
Declines led advancing issues by 2171 to 1931 on volume of about 582 million shares.

And if Peak were not enough, EIS International Inc tumbled 5-1/8 to 7-7/8 after saying it would not meet analysts' third quarter revenue and earnings estimates because of delays in key orders and disappointing results from its international efforts.
Intel Corp briefly topped 100 for the first timwe today intraday but closed at 99-1/2, up 1/2.
